prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
(none yet)

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
(not available)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 79.1%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 83.3%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 77.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 91.9%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 30.3%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, new_screen] Interactive Desktop Tray Sandbox Guide Screen: Add a dedicated interactive sandbox screen at the end of onboarding that lets users test pet tray controls and desktop visibility settings before finishing. (why: Finish step has a 64.8% completion rate and a long mean duration of 5815s; support emails highlight user confusion over controlling and hiding the desktop pet after setup.)
1: [home, redesign] Desktop Engine Initialization Checklist Redesign: Redesign the waiting screen into a dynamic checklist layout showing live step-by-step progress for desktop overlay rendering and pet engine startup. (why: Home waiting stage takes a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, and support users reported instances where pet rendering stalled or failed to open.)
2: [adoption, new_flow] Pet Customization Sound and Gesture Preview Flow: Introduce an interactive sound and movement preview workflow directly on the pick friend adoption screen. (why: Adoption has a 22.7% drop-off rate and 1017s mean duration, with support mail reporting confusion regarding custom pet behavior.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery Sync Status Disclaimer: Display a persistent sign-in status hint reassuring users that signing in syncs existing adopted pets safely. (why: Support received 8 reports of pets missing or resetting after users signed in again.)
4: [home, wait_info] Desktop Pet Render Delay Time Indicator: Add an estimated completion timer and clear progress wait info on the waiting screen during desktop engine setup. (why: Home wait step shows heavy variance with a median of 201s and mean of 2336s, leading users to think the app froze.)
5: [finish, copy] Desktop Pet Quick Hotkey Reference Copy: Update the home intro body copy to explicitly instruct users on tray icons and hotkey toggles to control their pet. (why: Support received multiple tickets complaining that users do not know how to hide, show, or control their pet after setup.)
6: [adoption, incentive] Custom Pet Photo Quality Checklist Callout: Provide a high-contrast checklist component on the photo upload screen outlining lighting and angle recommendations. (why: Support logged 3 issues where custom pet generation failed or produced low-quality desktop assets.)
7: [choose_path, notification] Path Explorer Background Setup Prompt: Add a notification badge on the path selection screen confirming background engine initialization. (why: Mean step time in choose_path reaches 514s; starting engine warmup earlier reduces later waiting bottlenecks.)

scores.note: Finish step has highest drop-off (35.2%) and long delays; new screen requires build effort.
Home step has high conversion (91.9%) despite long wait times, but redesign is costly.
Adoption loses 22.7% of users; preview flow targets support issues but requires a new flow.
Low cost disclaimer addresses explicit support feedback around pet sync anxiety.
Clear progress indicator addresses heavy wait time variance without needing a full redesign.
Copy change directly addresses massive finish drop-off and support confusion at low cost.
Only 3 support tickets logged; moderate impact on overall adoption drop-off.
Choose path drops 20.9% and has high mean time; background warmup helps early bottleneck.
